english.title: Cause contravention of tree preservation regulations by cutting down / uprooting / wilfully destroying a tree
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in contravention of the Town and Country Planning (Tree Preservation) (England) Regulations 2012 caused the cutting down, uprooting or wilful destruction of a tree located at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 210(1)(c) and (2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
